purpose: SOP 2 - memory, CPU, storage and device resource information, plus background load

collection.method: read-only shell collection; no benchmark, no workload, no service termination

field_status_legend.system_report: value reported by the running operating system
field_status_legend.tool_report: value reported by the vendor toolchain
field_status_legend.measured: value observed on site during this collection
field_status_legend.unverified: not cross-checked against a second source
field_status_legend.not_supported: the platform does not expose the field at all
field_status_legend.not_accessible: the field exists but could not be read with the privileges used

core_count.note: Thread(s) per core = 1 and Core(s) per socket = 4, so physical, logical and available counts are all 4 - there is no SMT and no offline core

architecture.value: 4 x ARM Cortex-A53 (ARMv8-A), aarch64, little endian

frequency.note: no cpufreq sysfs, no cpu_opp_table, no clock-frequency property; operating-points-v2 is commented out in the shipped device tree. The 1 GHz figure is 官方规格 only.

l2.note: the shipped DTB l2-cache node has no cache-size property, which is why the kernel publishes no size

numa_nodes.note: numactl absent; dmesg shows one memory node with 262144 pages, consistent with a single node but not confirmed by a topology query

governor.note: no cpufreq interface, so no performance/schedule governor exists

power_management.value: PSCI idle states with a cpu-sleep-0 state (arm,psci-suspend-param 0x40000000, entry latency 300 us, exit 600 us, min residency 10000 us)

temperature.note: no thermal zone is exposed by the platform

power_draw.note: the vendor specifies ~8 W typical; no measurement was performed

batch_3.note: the board is essentially idle on average; the 8.7% figure below is a single process's share of one core, not a system-wide load

ram_total_kb.note: the kernel command line fixes the PS memory window at mem=1024M; dmesg reports 'Memory limited to 1024MB' and 754920K/1048576K available at boot

ram_available_kb.note: two samples 40 s apart in batch 1 gave MemAvailable 721084 kB and 720196 kB

ram_free_kb.note: sample 2 in the same batch showed 413388 kB; the board is not under memory pressure

ram_type_bandwidth.note: theoretical figure from the manual; the number of channels was not read out of the memory controller and no bandwidth measurement was performed

measured_bandwidth.note: SOP 2 forbids performance runs, so no STREAM-like measurement was attempted

swap.zram: not enabled (no /dev/zram* and no zram mount)

u_dma_buf_pool.note: a 128 MiB slab carved out of the CMA pool; this is the buffer path the NPU stack uses

memory_limits.note: no cgroup memory ceiling exists on this bare board; the only memory-related limits are the ulimits (max locked memory 64 MiB, max stack 8 MiB)

root.note: the root filesystem is 78-80% full. Model and experiment files should not be placed here without checking the free space; /mnt/wcis-emmc (29 GiB) is the separate volume, but it was not mounted during batch 3.

data_volume.caveat: mounted in batch 1, not mounted in batch 3. The mount point existed but was empty and df fell back to the root filesystem.

mount_mechanism.managed_by: systemd oneshot unit wcis-face-storage.service (Type=oneshot, RemainAfterExit=yes, After=local-fs.target, Before=wcis-face-photo.service)
mount_mechanism.not_managed_by: fstab - the live /etc/fstab is the vendor stub ('# UNCONFIGURED FSTAB FOR BASE SYSTEM') plus a comment pointing at the service
mount_mechanism.identity_check: mount is refused unless the partition UUID matches 67104a06-74a6-4268-a124-269d1b232a28 (LABEL WCIS_FACE, TYPE ext4)

batch_3_absence_explanation.verdict: not a flaky mount - that boot never brought the eMMC up at all
batch_3_absence_explanation.boot_id: -4, 2026-10-20 06:48:22 - 07:50:19 UTC (the collection ran at 07:49:07Z, 72 s before that boot ended)
facts: the wcis-face-storage.service produced no journal entry at all in that boot, while every other recorded boot logs Starting / 'Personnel eMMC filesystem mounted and verified' / Finished and, at shutdown, Stopping / Stopped
the kernel log of that boot contains no mmcblk1 or ext4 mount line, while boots -5 and -3 both contain 'EXT4-fs (mmcblk1p1): mounted filesystem with ordered data mode'
that boot also lost the serial console (dev-ttyPS0.device failed with result 'timeout') and logged a stream of 'sshd: kex_exchange_identification: Connection closed by remote host' every ~10 s
it ended with 'FAT-fs (mmcblk0p1): Volume was not properly unmounted. Some data may be corrupt. Please run fsck.' followed by systemd-shutdown - a hard reset, not a clean shutdown

board_availability_note.fact: the board rebooted 8 times between 06:17 and 13:12 on 2026-10-20 (journal boots -7..0) while this collection was running; the eMMC is unmounted and remounted at every one of those reboots
board_availability_note.implication: any later measurement on this board must record which boot it was taken in - the machine is under active work by someone else and its state is not stable across a session

sd_card.layout: p1 1 GiB FAT boot, p2 26.1 GiB ext4 rootfs

qspi_nor.partitions: bootloader 4 MiB, kernel 16 MiB, rootfs 0 bytes

npu.dt_node: none - grepping the flattened device tree for 'npu' / 'aiu' / 'zhuge' / 'icore' returns 0 hits
npu.access_path: axi://zg330aiu?npu=0x40000000&dma=0x80000000 - two PL AXI slave windows mapped from the PS side
npu.device_node: none exported; there is no NPU kernel module at all
npu.compute_capacity_note: the 8 TOPS @ INT8 / 4 TFLOPS @ FP16 / 2 TFLOPS @ TF32 figures are 官方规格 from the vendor manual. No workload was run, so the achievable throughput on this board is unknown and must not be inferred from the specification.
npu.official_spec_value: 8 TOPS @ INT8, 4 TFLOPS @ FP16, 2 TFLOPS @ TF32
npu.correction: 2026-10-23 (D-79): the 'device', 'driver', 'state' entries and the old 'device_node' text described the VPU (video codec), which is now recorded under the 'vpu' key below. Raw logs were left intact; only the attribution changed.

vpu.device: vpu: mve@F0020000 (arm china,linlon-v5) - a video codec, not the NPU
vpu.state: probed at ~9.5 s after boot, platform device f0020000.mve bound, kernel threads mvx_sched active
vpu.firmware: /lib/firmware/linlon-v52_v76-80-2/ - 17 codec .fwb blobs (mpeg4dec, avs2dec, vp9dec, h264enc, h264enc.prot-ver, jpegdec, avsdec, mpeg2dec, vp8enc, hevcdec, rvdec, h264dec, vp8dec, vc1dec, hevcenc, jpegenc, vp9enc)
vpu.correction: 2026-10-23 (D-79): moved out of the 'npu' key, where it had been filed by mistake. The collection script itself assumed MVE == NPU (collect_followup.sh:51).

gpu.driver: Mali DDK r31p0-01eac0, GPU id 0x2, arch 7.4.0 r1p0
gpu.state: probed, /dev/mali0 present, memory group manager active, coherency mode 31
gpu.memory: unknown - no GPU memory size is published in sysfs and the debugfs gpuinfo path is empty

fpga.device: fpga_manager fpga0 (FMSH FMQL FPGA Manager, e0040000.devcfg)
fpga.state: operating - a bitstream was already loaded before collection started
fpga.occupancy_note: no utilisation report or tool output was available. The device capacities (125K logic, 78,600 LUT, 9.3 Mb BRAM, 400 DSP) are 官方规格 and describe the device, not the occupancy of the running design. Do not read them as measured usage.

dma.controllers: dw_dmac e004b000.dma (8 channels) and dw_axi_dmac_platform f0010000.dma (8 channels)

competing_workloads.note: the project's own SDI video pipeline was already running on the board during collection and is holding a meaningful share of one core. Any later throughput measurement on this board is taken under this background load unless it is stopped first - and SOP 2 forbids stopping other tasks.

resource_contention.value: CPU: a background SDI pipeline plus two python3 services are resident. Memory: ~700 MiB available of 993 MiB, so memory is not constrained. NPU: idle - no NPU workload was running. GPU: idle. FPGA: occupied by a loaded bitstream, with unknown occupancy.

system_services.value: standard Ubuntu base (systemd, ssh, cron, rsyslog, dbus, alsa-utils, unattended-upgrades) plus the board's own SDI video processes

items.reason: no cpufreq, no OPP table, no clock-frequency property in the device tree

items.field: L1/L2 cache capacity as reported by the kernel
items.reason: the shipped DTB l2-cache node carries no cache-size property, so sysfs publishes no size; only the structure (level/type/sharing) is observable
no thermal zone exposed by the platform
numactl is not installed and no topology query was run
no utilisation report or tool output available; SOP 2 forbids presenting occupancy as measured
the memory controller configuration was not read out and no bandwidth measurement was performed
no PCI device is enumerated and lspci is not installed
the fpga_manager firmware attribute is write-only and no bitstream metadata is published
no serial-number or board-name property in the device tree
SOP 2 forbids running inference or benchmarks, so the NPU throughput remains the vendor specification only
